title: asn2wrs: Rename option for no constraints check
description:
Rename the option for no constraints check from -C to -N to avoid
ambiguity after the change to default add constraints check.

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 1230789e - asn2wrs: Rename option for no constraints check
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22584/diffs?diff_id=1586766635&start_sha=6cb37a92dd184ccd784f78576c8b161196f66c21)
enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2

commits_data.message:
asn2wrs: Rename option for no constraints check

Rename the option for no constraints check from -C to -N to avoid
ambiguity after the change to default add constraints check.
